# `assignment-to-input`: Module logic assigns to an input port / 模块内部对输入端口进行了赋值

**Severity / 严重程度:** `error`

## English

### Cause

Logic inside the module writes an input port even though that signal is owned and driven by the parent module.

### Risk

Competing ownership can create multiple drivers, obscure the true data source, and produce simulation or synthesis errors.

### Fix

Treat the input as read-only and write any transformed value to an internal signal or an output port instead.

## 简体中文

### 原因

模块内部逻辑写入了输入端口，但该信号应由上层模块拥有并驱动。

### 风险

信号所有权冲突可能造成多驱动、掩盖真实数据来源，并引发仿真或综合错误。

### 修复

将输入端口视为只读，把转换后的值写入内部信号或输出端口。

## Failing example / 问题示例

```systemverilog
module assignment_to_input(
  input logic data_i,
  input logic force_low,
  output logic data_o
);
  always_comb begin
    if (force_low) data_i = 1'b0;
    data_o = data_i;
  end
endmodule
```

## Fixed example / 修复示例

```systemverilog
module assignment_to_input(
  input logic data_i,
  input logic force_low,
  output logic data_o
);
  logic selected_data;

  always_comb begin
    selected_data = data_i;
    if (force_low) selected_data = 1'b0;
    data_o = selected_data;
  end
endmodule
```
